name: S2_ Dynamic Drive and Clarification Gate v0.1

parameters.jsCode: const expected=["product-brief.txt","meeting-transcripts.txt","stakeholder-notes.txt","stakeholder-clarifications-2026-08-07.md","stakeholder-clarification-amendment-2026-08-07.md","stakeholder-clarification-mobile-release-2026-08-07.md"];const items=$input.all();const names=items.map(i=>i.json.name).sort();const wanted=[...expected].sort();const errors=[];if(items.length!==6)errors.push('expected exactly six Drive files');if(JSON.stringify(names)!==JSON.stringify(wanted))errors.push('Drive filename allowlist mismatch');for(const item of items){if(!item.json.id)errors.push('missing Drive file id for '+item.json.name);if(item.json.mimeType==='application/vnd.google-apps.folder')errors.push('nested folder returned');}if(errors.length)throw new Error('Google Drive production input gate failed closed: '+errors.join('; '));return items.map(i=>({json:{...i.json,drive_input_validated:true,drive_folder_id:'1SxIfeNPCcGQQT4DqsRdEq9DMruwCkYaS'}}));

nodes.name: Build Dynamic Drive Packet and Citation Inventory

parameters.jsCode: const stage=$input.first().json,original=$('Build Dynamic Drive Packet and Citation Inventory').first().json,e=[];if(stage.stage!=='requirement_extraction'||stage.execution_status!=='passed')e.push('extractor stage');if(stage.run_id!==original.run_id)e.push('run_id');if(stage.groundedness_percent!==100||stage.validation?.unsupported_claims!==0)e.push('grounding');if(stage.observability?.parent_trace_id!==original.orchestration_context.parent_trace_id)e.push('parent trace');const expected=original.sources.flatMap(s=>s.citations.map(c=>c.citation_id)),actual=stage.source_packet?.citation_inventory?.map(c=>c.citation_id)||[];if(expected.length!==actual.length||new Set(actual).size!==actual.length||expected.some(id=>!actual.includes(id)))e.push('citation inventory set');if((stage.output?.extractor_notes||[]).length!==expected.length)e.push('citation classification count');if(e.length)throw new Error('S2 extraction failed closed: '+e.join('; '));return [{json:{schema_version:'2.0.0',run_id:stage.run_id,extraction:stage.output,orchestration_context:original.orchestration_context,requirement_extraction_stage:stage,original_packet:original}}];

nodes.name: Validate Dynamic Extraction and Citation Set

parameters.jsCode: const stage=$input.first().json,prior=$('Validate Dynamic Extraction and Citation Set').first().json,e=[];if(stage.stage!=='gap_analysis'||stage.execution_status!=='passed')e.push('gap stage');if(stage.run_id!==prior.run_id)e.push('run_id');if(stage.groundedness_percent!==100||stage.validation?.unsupported_claims!==0)e.push('grounding');const packet=prior.original_packet,citations=packet.sources.flatMap(s=>s.citations.map(c=>({...c,source_id:s.source_id,source_name:s.source_name,source_type:s.source_type,content_hash:s.content_hash}))),byKey=new Map(citations.map(c=>[c.source_id+'|'+c.location,c])),rows=prior.extraction.extractor_notes||[],seen=new Set(),classifications=[];for(const row of rows){const m=String(row).match(/^([^|]+)\|(line:[1-9][0-9]*)\|(ITEM|MISSING|CONFLICT|CONTEXT|METADATA)\|(.+)$/);if(!m){e.push('invalid classification');continue;}const key=m[1]+'|'+m[2],citation=byKey.get(key);if(!citation||seen.has(citation.citation_id)){e.push('unknown or duplicate classification '+key);continue;}seen.add(citation.citation_id);classifications.push({citation_id:citation.citation_id,route:m[3],target_ids:m[4]==='NONE'?[]:m[4].split(','),source_id:citation.source_id,location:citation.location});}if(seen.size!==citations.length)e.push('citation classification set mismatch');if(e.length)throw new Error('S2 deterministic gate failed closed: '+e.join('; '));return [{json:{schema_version:'2.0.0',result_type:'s2_dynamic_gate',run_id:prior.run_id,execution_status:'passed',contract_status:'passed',packet_id:packet.packet_id,parent_trace_id:prior.orchestration_context.parent_trace_id,source_packet:{sources:packet.sources,source_manifest:packet.sources.map(({raw_text,citations,...s})=>({...s,citation_count:citations.length})),citation_inventory:citations},requirement_extraction:prior.extraction,gap_analysis:stage.output,citation_classifications:classifications,generation_gate:{gate_status:'eligible_for_human_approval',route:'human_review',human_approval_required:true},groundedness_percent:100,unsupported_claims:0,next_route:'human_approval',recorded_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];
